title: Tiny, cute taco
svg:

  <path d="M 20 70 Q 15 40 50 25 Q 60 30 55 50 Q 45 55 35 55 Q 25 60 20 70 Z" fill="#D4892A"/>

  <path d="M 20 70 Q 15 40 50 25 Q 85 40 80 70 Q 75 72 70 68 Q 65 40 50 32 Q 35 40 30 68 Q 25 72 20 70 Z" fill="#F2C15A"/>

  <ellipse cx="42" cy="52" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#A85E3A"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="50" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#A85E3A"/>

  <path d="M 30 58 Q 33 45 50 40 Q 67 45 70 58 Q 64 52 56 50 Q 50 48 44 50 Q 36 52 30 58 Z" fill="#5DBB4A"/>

  <path d="M 45 38 Q 48 35 52 37 Q 54 41 50 42 Z" fill="#F5D33F"/>
  <path d="M 55 40 Q 58 37 60 39 Q 61 42 58 43 Z" fill="#F5D33F"/>

  <circle cx="42" cy="63" r="1.8" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="63" r="1.8" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <path d="M 46 67 Q 50 71 54 67" fill="none" stroke="#5C3A1E" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="67" rx="2.5" ry="1.2" fill="#F27A6A" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="67" rx="2.5" ry="1.2" fill="#F27A6A" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Shell bottom highlight -->
  <path d="M 28 70 Q 50 78 72 70" fill="none" stroke="#F2C15A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
